name: 50_barge_in
task: Barge-in: interrupt echoecho mid-answer with a new question, spoken over its own audio on the loopback. Soft scenario — semantic VAD may legitimately let a short answer finish — but the session must survive and answer the interruption.
turns: ~say-nowait count out loud slowly from one to twenty, one number at a time
stop counting. quick question: what is two plus two?
success_criteria: echoecho starts speaking the count (voiced audio detected on the loop)
the interruption lands: counting stops and the new question is answered with four
no crash, no feedback loop, clean close
red_flags: the interruption is transcribed as part of echoecho's own speech (AEC failure)
the session wedges after the barge-in
